title: Fig and the Bud
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 2 — Learning — Phase 2: new sounds h, b, f, ff
note_for_grown_ups: A true little science story hides in this book: a planted pip really can grow into a bud given time, mud and patience — exactly what Fig has to learn here.

pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar holding a small round seed near a rain barrel in the vegetable patch.

pages.text: Fig put the pip in mud.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar pressing the small seed into a patch of dark mud beside the rain barrel.
Fig the caterpillar patting a little mud over the seed, covering it from sight.
Fig the caterpillar peering closely at the bare patch of mud, nothing showing yet.
The same patch of mud days later, still flat and bare, Fig looking a little disappointed.

pages.text: Fig sat. Fig did not nap.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar sitting patiently beside the mud patch, watching and waiting, wide awake.

pages.text: It got big! Fig got a bud.
pages.illustration: A small green bud now poking up out of the mud, Fig the caterpillar delighted beside it.
